category_title: High-achieving students with proactive study habits and consistent attendance
scenario_title: Metacognitive reflection on study habits after biology exams
minimal_context: A student is reviewing their recent biology exam and discussing study habits during a peer fellow session.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Welcome to the peer fellow session. Let's talk about the recent biology exam and your study habits.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I really need help to determine the causes of my difficulty on this exam. I thought I was prepared.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: How did you prepare for it?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I did my usual routine, but now I'm second-guessing everything. I don't feel confident in my habits anymore.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Take a look at the graphs of study habits on the document posted online.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I see the data, but I'm just overwhelmed and reacting to my score. I don't know how to combine these habits to find the best fit or figure out what actually went wrong for me.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Welcome to the peer fellow session. Let's talk about the recent biology exam and your study habits.

STUDENT: I really need help to determine the causes of my difficulty on this exam. I thought I was prepared.

TUTOR: How did you prepare for it?

STUDENT: I did my usual routine, but now I'm second-guessing everything. I don't feel confident in my habits anymore.

TUTOR: Take a look at the graphs of study habits on the document posted online.

STUDENT: I see the data, but I'm just overwhelmed and reacting to my score. I don't know how to combine these habits to find the best fit or figure out what actually went wrong for me.

task.content: Participating in group discussions during SI sessions about combining study habits and comparing personal habits to high-achieving peers' data
task.learning_goal: determine the causes of my difficulty and be less reactionary and more proactive in facing subsequent exams

context.environment: peer fellow study sessions for first-year Biology students
context.materials: accessible data, graphical representations of study habits on a brief document containing each graph that Nash posted on the course’s online homepage

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: after their tests when trying to determine the causes of my difficulty
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Being reactionary in facing subsequent exams
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Lacking confidence until seeing how their high-achieving peers studied made them feel more confident in their habits

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Being reactionary rather than proactive in facing subsequent exams
Needing help to determine the causes of my difficulty
